WITH bucket_aggregates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS bucket1_count,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS bucket1_ext_tax,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS bucket1_net_paid_inc_tax,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS bucket2_count,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS bucket2_ext_tax,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS bucket2_net_paid_inc_tax,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS bucket3_count,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS bucket3_ext_tax,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS bucket3_net_paid_inc_tax,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS bucket4_count,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS bucket4_ext_tax,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS bucket4_net_paid_inc_tax,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS bucket5_count,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS bucket5_ext_tax,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS bucket5_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN bucket_aggregates.bucket1_count > 1071 THEN bucket_aggregates.bucket1_ext_tax
        ELSE bucket_aggregates.bucket1_net_paid_inc_tax
    END AS bucket1,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket_aggregates.bucket2_count > 39161 THEN bucket_aggregates.bucket2_ext_tax
        ELSE bucket_aggregates.bucket2_net_paid_inc_tax
    END AS bucket2,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket_aggregates.bucket3_count > 29434 THEN bucket_aggregates.bucket3_ext_tax
        ELSE bucket_aggregates.bucket3_net_paid_inc_tax
    END AS bucket3,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket_aggregates.bucket4_count > 6568 THEN bucket_aggregates.bucket4_ext_tax
        ELSE bucket_aggregates.bucket4_net_paid_inc_tax
    END AS bucket4,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket_aggregates.bucket5_count > 21216 THEN bucket_aggregates.bucket5_ext_tax
        ELSE bucket_aggregates.bucket5_net_paid_inc_tax
    END AS bucket5
FROM reason
INNER JOIN bucket_aggregates
    ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
